name: MoviePilot-V3
description: MoviePilot V3 is an automation hub for a home media library. It watches your subscriptions, searches your indexers, hands the release to your existing BitTorrent client, then renames, hardlinks and scrapes the finished files into a clean library and refreshes your media server. Highlights: - Subscribe to movies and TV shows and let MoviePilot find and download them automatically. - Works with your existing downloaders, media servers, metadata sources and notification channels. - Automatic organising: renaming, hardlinking, NFO/artwork scraping and media server refresh. - Plugin and workflow system for extending behaviour without touching the core. Setup notes: - The web UI runs on port 3000. On first start open it and complete the setup wizard. - Map /media and /downloads under the same Unraid share (for example /mnt/user/) so hardlinks work instead of copies. - Settings live in /config/app.env and can also be edited from the web UI. Documentation: https://wiki.movie-pilot.org Project home: https://movie-pilot.org This template is community maintained and is not produced by the MoviePilot authors. Support requests for the template belong in the Unraid support thread; bugs in MoviePilot itself belong upstream. ===== 简体中文 ===== MoviePilot V3 是一款面向家庭影音库的自动化管理工具：自动订阅、搜索资源、调用已有的 BT 下载器下载，下载完成后自动重命名、硬链接、刮削元数据并通知媒体服务器刷新。 使用提示： - Web 界面端口为 3000，首次启动后打开页面完成初始化向导。 - /media 与 /downloads 请映射到同一个 Unraid 共享（例如 /mnt/user/）下，否则无法硬链接，只能复制。 - 配置保存在 /config/app.env，也可以在 Web 界面中修改。 本模板由社区维护，非 MoviePilot 官方出品。模板相关问题请在 Unraid 支持贴反馈，程序本身的问题请到上游仓库反馈。

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Configuration, database and cache. Keep this on the cache/appdata share.

paths.name: Media Library
paths.description: Your media library, e.g. /mnt/user/media/. Must be on the same share as the download folder if you want hardlinks.

paths.name: Downloads
paths.description: The download folder used by your BitTorrent client, e.g. /mnt/user/downloads/. Must be on the same share as the media library if you want hardlinks.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Optional. Only needed by plugins that restart containers. Leave empty unless you use one of them.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for the MoviePilot web interface.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the application runs as. 99 is the standard Unraid nobody user.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the application runs as. 100 is the standard Unraid users group.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: File mode creation mask used for files written by the application.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Container timezone, e.g. Asia/Shanghai, Europe/Berlin, America/New_York.

variables.name: NGINX_PORT
variables.description: Port the built-in web server listens on inside the container. Change this only together with the WebUI Port mapping above.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Internal API port. Only change this if it clashes with something else inside the container.

variables.name: MOVIEPILOT_AUTO_UPDATE
variables.description: Update the application on container start: release, dev, or false to disable.

variables.name: PROXY_HOST
variables.description: Optional HTTP proxy used for outbound requests, e.g. http://user:password@192.168.1.2:7890

variables.name: GITHUB_PROXY
variables.description: Optional GitHub mirror prefix used when downloading updates and plugins, e.g. https://ghproxy.net/

variables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
variables.description: Optional GitHub personal access token used to raise the API rate limit for updates and plugin downloads.

variables.name: MOVIEPILOT_FORCE_CHOWN
variables.description: Set to true for one start if the application reports permission errors on its cache directories. Slows down startup.
